name: Hemacore-V9
description: Hemacore-V9 is a vascularized iron-titanium matrix seeded with engineered hemocyte colonies that circulate through microscopic internal channels, delivering oxygen and metabolic substrates to living cellular components embedded throughout the alloy. Damage triggers a clotting-and-remodeling cascade identical in principle to wound healing in organic tissue, closing micro-fractures within hours and full structural breaches within days given sufficient metabolic supply. BioForge Labs developed it as a direct response to the chronic failure rates of passive self-healing alloys, arguing that only genuinely living repair mechanisms could match the reliability of biological tissue.
applications: structural framing for subdermal augment housings
trauma plating for combat medics requiring field-repairable armor
story_hooks: A black-market surgeon is harvesting Hemacore-V9 from cadavers — the material stays alive for up to 72 hours post-mortem if kept warm, and someone is paying very well for fresh panels

A character's Hemacore implant begins rejecting after exposure to an industrial toxin that is killing the embedded hemocyte colonies, and replacement stock has mysteriously vanished from every licensed supplier in the district
The material's vascular network can, under the right conditions, be colonized by engineered pathogens — a bioweapon designed specifically to kill people through their own implants
